physics_test.name: EFCLASS sign test: ΔH² negative for additive gate
physics_test.description: Background-only EFC gate E²=E²_LCDM + A·g(a) with closure Ω_Λ→Ω_Λ-A·g(1) produces ΔH²<0 for all z>0. This increases growth (fσ₈ +0.5-0.8%) rather than suppressing it. Verified analytically and numerically in CLASS v3.3.4. 9/9 z-points match to <0.1%. This means S₈ suppression requires perturbation-level μ<1, not background friction.
physics_test.data_source: EFCLASS v0.1 CLASS background output, BOSS DR12 fσ₈ comparison
physics_test.prediction: Additive background gate with closure normalisation always gives ΔH<0 at z>0, increasing fσ₈. Only μ(k,z)<1 or inverted gate can suppress growth.
physics_test.notes: Core physics validation. Tester ontologisk konsistens: ΔH² < 0 i additive gate er nødvendig for at hele EFC-mekanismen (Hubble-friksjon → vekst-undertrykkelse) skal holde. Hvis tegnet er feil kollapser motoren. Nivå: Retning/signatur.

physics_test.name: MVP-G1 fσ₈ Leave-One-Out Robustness (N2a mode)
physics_test.description: Leave-One-Out stress test of EFC Hubble friction channel (α parameter) in growth sector. 7 fσ₈ data points (z=0.02-0.85) + 14 BAO points, N2a mode (rd=147.09, σ₈~N(0.81,0.02)). Tests whether α<0 signal is driven by any single data point. Combined with rd-independence test (N1) and σ₈-control test (N2), this completes a three-part robustness validation of the growth-sector hint. Result: 7/7 LOO runs pass (|α|/σ ≥ 1.84 AND ΔAIC ≤ 0). α stable in range [-1.11, -0.88]. No single fσ₈ measurement drives the hint. Correlations stable across LOO: corr(α,Ωm) ≈ +0.59, corr(α,σ₈) ≈ -0.26.
physics_test.data_source: fσ₈ extended compilation (7 points, z=0.02-0.85): 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (3 bins), eBOSS, Vipers. BAO compilation (14 points). Pipeline: MVP-G1 Hubble Friction Channel with N2a nuisance controls.
physics_test.prediction: EFC predicts late-time growth suppression (α<0) in Hubble friction channel. Signal should be distributed across redshift range, not concentrated in any single measurement. LOO robustness score should be ≥6/7 for the hint to qualify as non-artefactual.
physics_test.notes: Approved. DOI published: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31332730. Three-part robustness validation (N1+N2+T7) complete. 7/7 LOO pass, α stable [-1.11, -0.88], no single data point drives signal. Status: Completed (robust hint). First systematic LOO robustness paper for any LCDM alternative in growth sector.

physics_test.name: χ-monotonicity in galaxy cluster radial profiles
physics_test.description: Test whether χ(r) = |∇δT(r)|/T₀ ∝ |dΦ_N/dr| increases monotonically from outskirts to core in galaxy clusters within [0.05, 1.0] R₅₀₀. Uses WL mass profiles (HSC/KiDS/DES) or X-ray hydrostatic profiles (eROSITA ER1) to reconstruct Φ_N(r). Tests cool-core and non-cool-core separately. Kill if ≥30% of gold-sample clusters show robust bumps (surviving bootstrap resampling ≥90%), or if cool-core vs non-cool-core require systematically different χ-forms.
physics_test.data_source: eROSITA ER1 cluster catalog + XMM/Chandra gold subsample for X-ray T(r) profiles. HSC/KiDS/DES cluster WL mass profiles for Φ_N(r) reconstruction. Classification: cool-core vs non-cool-core from X-ray concentration measure.
physics_test.prediction: χ(r) is monotonically increasing (Spearman ρ < -0.8 between r and χ) from 1.0 R₅₀₀ to 0.05 R₅₀₀ in both cool-core and non-cool-core clusters, with ≤1 sign change in dχ/dr after Savitzky-Golay smoothing. If this holds, χ is validated as universal regime index. If it fails, χ-concept dies but grid ontology, dual readout, and ×4800 resolution survive.
physics_test.notes: FIRST DOOR TO RISK. Highest-value kill-test because: (1) data exists now (eROSITA ER1 + WL profiles), (2) independent of WP4 baseline, (3) genuinely risky (cool-core variations could kill it). Kill conditions: Kill A = ≥30% gold sample shows robust bumps. Kill B = CC vs NCC require different χ-forms. Kill C = stacking masks non-monotonicity. Failure modes: inner-core-only fail is salvageable (AGN subregime), broad fail kills single-scalar gating. This test must run BEFORE η(a,k,ρ) fitting or T₀→Λ mapping.

If a joint fit with free σ8_0 resolves the tension (σ8_0 shifts to ~0.78-0.80), it confirms EFC is consistent. If the tension persists even with free σ8_0, it indicates the gate function needs modification (separate growth coupling).

If σ8_0 remains at Planck value (0.811) while A>0 is preferred, this indicates a genuine growth-geometry mismatch requiring modified growth coupling.

Kritisk tolkning: Hvis spenning forsvinner uten ekstrem σ8_0 → robust. Krever unaturlig σ8_0 → manglende mekanisme. Spenning består → bakgrunnsmodul utilstrekkelig. Nivå: Global konsistens (sekundær).
